description: This file defines the SSECMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for simplifying the process of server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) in Amazon S3 operations. It includes methods for wrapping handlers, constructing the middleware, invoking encryption parameter preparation, and encoding encryption keys and their MD5 hashes.

classes.name: Aws\S3\SSECMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles encoding and hashing of customer-provided encryption keys for Amazon S3 server-side encryption with customer keys (SSE-C). It ensures the keys are properly prepared and ensures HTTPS is used.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a handler wrapper that injects the endpoint scheme into the middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with endpoint scheme and the next handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Method called when the middleware is invoked; it checks the scheme, prepares encryption parameters for the command.

methods.name: prepareSseParams
methods.description: Prepares the SSE-C parameters by base64 encoding the key and its MD5 hash.
